highlights: Frontier AI models continue to advance rapidly, with OpenAI launching GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, Alibaba introducing the massive Qwen4-Max, and Liquid AI debuting omnimodal decision models, significantly boosting capabilities across various applications.

The ecosystem for building and deploying AI is maturing, marked by NVIDIA open-sourcing tools for GPU Kubernetes infrastructure, SpecRelay optimizing edge-cloud LLM inference, and new research enhancing the robustness and ethical considerations of AI agents.

Major tech players are doubling down on practical AI integration, exemplified by Google upgrading its Search with Gemini 4 Hydrogen and launching a dedicated Gemini for healthcare, alongside Sarvam's initiative to offer India-hosted inference for open models.

agents.title: Video-as-Experience: Learning Computer Use via Audio-Visual Understanding
agents.summary: This research introduces VEX, a framework enabling computer-use agents to learn tasks from audio-visual tutorials and self-verify, achieving a 22% task success increase and demonstrating significant advances in autonomous agent capabilities.

agents.title: More ways to move care forward with ChatGPT for Healthcare
agents.summary: OpenAI introduces new computer-use agents, improved clinical answers, and healthcare plugins for ChatGPT, enabling automation and enhanced workflows across healthcare software to perform real-world tasks.

agents.title: Ask Precisely, Assume Wisely: Interactive Evaluation of Ambiguity Resolution in Large Language Models
agents.summary: This framework evaluates LLM ambiguity resolution through a preference-grounded simulated user, revealing trade-offs in clarification-seeking versus assumption-making and demonstrating a 7.65% error rate reduction with optimized prompts, crucial for reliable human-AI interaction.

models.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
models.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, new flagship models that deliver improved professional outputs, coding, computer use, and efficiency at lower costs across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API.

models.title: Alibaba Releases Qwen4-Max: 2.4T MoE, 71B Active, 1M Context
models.summary: Alibaba launched Qwen4-Max, a proprietary 2.4T-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model featuring 71B active parameters, native vision, and a 1M-token context, significantly reducing task costs for enterprise applications.

models.title: Liquid AI Releases d1.2 and d1.2-ultra: Omnimodal Decision Models That Top the AA Decision Index
models.summary: Liquid AI introduced d1.2 and d1.2-ultra, omnimodal decision models capable of processing text, images, and audio to provide calibrated probabilities with zero output tokens, setting new benchmarks in AI decision-making.

tools.title: SpecRelay: Amortize or Avoid the Round Trip in Edge-Cloud Speculative Decoding
tools.summary: SpecRelay is an LLM inference system designed for edge-cloud deployments that amortizes and avoids network round trips in speculative decoding, improving decoding throughput by up to 50% and increasing efficiency for real-time applications.

tools.title: NVIDIA Open-Sources NVKE and NVKR for Managed Kubernetes on GPU Infrastructure
tools.summary: NVIDIA has open-sourced NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE) and NVIDIA Kubernetes Recipes (NVKR, both Apache 2.0), enabling AI factories to run managed Kubernetes services directly on their bare-metal GPU servers, simplifying infrastructure management.

tools.title: Stanford Research Open-Sources Memorilla, a Latent Memory Module for Frozen LLMs
tools.summary: Stanford researchers open-sourced Memorilla, a memory system that compresses document collections into few memory tokens for frozen LLMs, achieving high accuracy with significantly fewer tokens and enhancing long-context processing efficiency.

companies.title: Google Search gets a major upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
companies.summary: Google is integrating Gemini 4 Hydrogen into Google Search globally, providing users with more helpful, visual, and intuitive responses, marking a significant evolution in its flagship product's AI capabilities.

companies.title: Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare.
companies.summary: Google Cloud has launched Gemini for healthcare, a specialized solution designed to unify clinical data and automate workflows, aiming to reduce administrative burnout and improve efficiency for healthcare teams.

companies.title: Sarvam Launches Sarvam Token Factory: Bringing India-Hosted Inference to 8 Open Models
companies.summary: Sarvam Token Factory is now public, offering India-hosted inference for eight open models, including Sarvam 105B and Gemma 4 31B, accessible via an OpenAI-compatible API, democratizing regional AI access.

learning.title: Clearing Up the Confusion on AI Data Retention: Two Standard Designs Explained
learning.summary: This guide clarifies AI data retention for developers, explaining two standard API designs for managing data deletion and offering six checks to ensure compliance and robust data privacy practices in AI applications.

learning.title: The Definitive Fine-Tuning Guide for 3D Generation Models
learning.summary: Hugging Face released a comprehensive guide for fine-tuning 3D generation models, providing essential knowledge and techniques for developers working with emerging 3D AI applications and asset creation.

learning.title: Broadening access to AI for scientists
learning.summary: OpenAI is expanding its ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program, offering 200,000 scientists worldwide free access to its frontier models, significantly lowering barriers to AI-driven scientific discovery and education.
